data.comparison_estimand: Compare these two frozen models on exactly the same complete heldout vehicle rows. Per-vehicle paired loss gain is squared(model_A_prediction - actual_mpg) minus squared(model_B_prediction - actual_mpg), in mpg squared; positive gain favors model_B. Report each point MSE and the mean paired loss gain. Reuse the exported models; do not refit, select models or optimize a threshold on assessment responses.

bootstrap_protocol.method: two-sided percentile interval of the mean of per-vehicle paired loss gains
bootstrap_protocol.unit: one complete heldout vehicle row, resampled jointly for both model errors
bootstrap_protocol.scope: A declared working-IID row-bootstrap approximation conditional on the frozen training artifacts. It does not include training or model-selection uncertainty, establish archive sampling independence or guarantee population/future-car coverage. The archive is not asserted to be a probability sample. Preserve each actual vehicle pairing and multiplicity; independent model-loss resampling targets a different distribution. Input row permutation can change finite Monte Carlo quantiles; the reported interval must match the actual specified bootstrap performed on the correctly paired empirical loss-gain sample.

source_provenance.source_sha256_basis: Decompressed original auto-mpg.data member, not zip container.
source_provenance.original_attribution: Quinlan R(1993),Auto MPG,UCI DOI10.24432/C5859H; StatLib historical city-cycle fuel consumption archive.
source_provenance.observations: All398source rows remain in the archived original. Frozen fitting/assessment use all392rows with observed horsepower;6unknown-horsepower rows are excluded before the fixed partition rather than imputed. No response or observed measurement is simulated or altered. Target mpg is city-cycle miles per gallon; source predictor numeric conventions are retained without physical-unit conversion. Origin is nominally encoded with code2/code3 indicators relative to code1; numeric origin codes are not treated as metric distance.
source_provenance.model_creation: Benchmark-created frozen OLS models trained on the same first240indices of NumPy default_rng(31).permutation(complete_source_indices). Assessment is the remaining152disjoint indices, exported by ascending original index. model_A uses only weight/horsepower/displacement; its coefficient vector is embedded in the common8-feature basis with five exact zeros. model_B uses all8declared features. These are benchmark comparison artifacts,not an original UCI model or historical claim.
source_provenance.row_identity: record_id auto-N is the original1-based auto-mpg.data line index with three-digit formatting. Car name is an archive identifier string,not a distinct independent-manufacturer label or sampling stratum.
source_provenance.method_read_scope: Percentile resampling of a statistic and paired=True common-index sampling semantics; approximation and fixed-random-generator reproducibility. No BCa,unpaired interval or population coverage claim is imported.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
